text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D at a gain and later buying it back at a higher price reminds me not to sell solely to lock in profit; I should have a clear reason and plan for re-entry.","My average cost can distort decisions: a loss or gain versus that price is not, by itself, a reason to hold or sell; I should judge each stock’s outlook and risk from today.","My account value rose overall but still fluctuated, so I should review my holdings periodically and make deliberate changes rather than react to short-term moves—or let positions go unchecked."]}
